description: This file defines the interface ILogViewAdaptorFactory used for creating log-view adaptors within the Orleans event sourcing framework. It specifies methods and properties that facilitate the construction and configuration of log-view adaptors for grains.

classes.name: ILogViewAdaptorFactory
classes.description: Interface to be implemented for a log-view adaptor factory, providing methods to create adaptors and indicate storage requirements.

methods.name: MakeLogViewAdaptor
methods.description: Constructs a log-view adaptor for the specified grain, with generics for view and log entry types.
